what_happened.line: The Council on Aging voted to have a member take steps toward adding a shower and making the center an official emergency shelter, including a capital plan request.
The council voted to send a member to the School Committee on its behalf about elevator signage and other ADA items.
A member volunteered for the town ADA committee, and the council discussed small ADA fixes at town hall described as modest expenses.
The council heard that the parking lot design contract has been issued, with pricing to follow and a separate capital request expected.
The council set a December meeting of the policies task force, with policy suggestions due by the end of November and a vote at a later meeting.

why_it_matters: A shower and shelter designation would turn the senior center into an emergency shelter, and the expansion and the parking lot would need capital funding that residents may be asked to approve at Town Meeting or through the capital plan.
Council priorities for the FY28 budget, such as meals site staffing and homebound services, feed into the town budget, which is mostly taxes.
watch_next: Pricing for the parking lot work, then a standalone capital request for town meeting or the next capital plan cycle.
Telehealth hub ribbon cutting on January 12, 2027, after the board meeting; policy suggestions due by end of November.
